title: Configuration encoding length bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with $k$ work tapes, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean word. For every natural number $s$ and every configuration $C$ of $N$ on input $x$, the encoding of $C$ has length at most $(2W+2)(s+\	ext{logSpace}(|x|)+1)$, where $W$ is the number of bits used to encode one tape cell and $\text{logSpace}(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over Bool
x is a finite Boolean input word
C is a configuration on input x
